messages:
alice (ml): heads up — our eval-runner surfaced ~120 artifacts that show up as 'partial' in the store and then get evicted by GC within minutes. noticed this on the new quant-llama-13b-4bit job run_id=run_2026_06_11_08

sam (infra): do you have an example object key? is this against s3 or our minio test cluster?

alice (ml): s3. example key: s3://redwood-eval-prod/artifacts/run_2026_06_11_08/eval-87321.trace.gz.part

ops-bot: trace-uploader v2 deployed to prod (rev 2026.6.11-3) — auto-retries enabled :rocket:

nina (data): partial uploads + short TTL is worrying for regulated datasets. if metadata doesn't mark PII we can't apply longer TTL. do we have PII flag in manifest?

alice (ml): current manifest schema is sparse. we have: evalid, model, quant, sample_count, size_bytes, gzip:bool. no explicit pii or checksum.

sam (infra): looking at S3 logs — several 403/RequestTimeout during multipart CompleteMultipartUpload. the uploader then leaves the .part objects and GC treats them as orphaned old files. GC kicks in based on age not ownership and removes them after 10m in this bucket config.

taylor (eng): I reproduced locally. root cause: eval-runner's trace-uploader calls CompleteMultipartUpload before async background finalizer confirms all parts recorded in artifact DB. if Complete succeeds but DB update fails (transient db timeout) we end up with parts that are uploaded but not referenced by the manifest -> GC path. patch: make CompleteMultipartUpload the last step after DB commit, and add a reconciliation job to scan multipart > 0 and assemble manifests.

alice (ml): +1 on reconciliation job. also we should add a checksum (sha256) to manifest and to an s3 object metadata header so we can detect truncated uploads during CI.

nina (data): also need pii: enum [none, low, high] in manifest so retention policy can be applied automatically. compliance needs 365d for high PII.

sam (infra): config options: current bucket lifecycle is 10m for incomplete multipart (we thought it was safe but looks aggressive). propose change: incomplete-multipart-retention -> 48h for prod-eval buckets; shorter for ephemeral dev.

ops-bot: deploy-trigger: patch/trace-uploader-db-order queued for canary — compiling.

alice (ml): CI wise — we should add a test that simulates an S3 500 during manifest write and ensure uploader doesn't call Complete until DB success. i can add a unit test and an integration test that spins up localstack and returns intermittent timeouts.

sam (infra): good. also add a healthcheck endpoint for uploader that reports outstanding partial objects per-run. that will let Console show an alert if partials > threshold.

nina (data): retention tiers proposed: raw-traces=30d default, indexed-transcripts=90d, pii-high=365d. small evals (<5MB) can be archived to cheaper storage after 7d. record this in data-policy doc.

alice (ml): here's a suggested manifest v2 fields:
```
manifest_v2: {
  evalid: string,
  run_id: string,
  model: string,
  quant: string,
  sample_count: int,
  gzip: bool,
  sha256: string,
  pii_level: string (none|low|high),
  uploader_version: string,
  created_at: iso8601
}
```

taylor (eng): I'll draft the change. quick snippet of the buggy uploader flow for reference:
```python
# simplified
upload_parts()
CompleteMultipartUpload()           # BAD: should be after DB commit
update_artifact_manifest_db()      # if this fails we leak reference
```

# fix:
update_artifact_manifest_db()
CompleteMultipartUpload()           # commit to s3 last
```

alice (ml): minor: we compress traces with gzip but don't always set content-encoding; add that too so proxies don't mangle.

sam (infra): adding to backlog: (1) bump incomplete-multipart lifecycle to 48h for eval-prod buckets, (2) add sha256 in manifest + s3 metadata, (3) add pii_level to manifest and mapping to TTL, (4) add reconcile job + uploader healthcheck, (5) CI tests for intermittent s3/db failures, (6) console alert for partials.

nina (data): please tag me on PRs for manifest changes. need to validate schema migration for older artifacts.

ops-bot: canary deploy started for patch/trace-uploader-db-order — watch: https://deploys.redwood.internal/c/trace-uploader/123

alice (ml): can we also add an eval-runner sideopt: when sample_count < 10, upload as single object (no multipart) to avoid multipart edgecases? that would reduce partial noise for small runs.

sam (infra): agreed. small objects go single-put with checksum header. multipart reserved for >8MB.

taylor (eng): I'll open the PR with uploader reorder + manifest v2 + unit tests. ETA EOD tomorrow. assigning to @sam and @nina for review.

alice (ml): thanks — this should stop the short-lived artifact evictions and make retention deterministic. will follow up if any new partials crop up after canary. :thumbsup:
